transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what's been going on that brought you in today?
I guess… I’m here because I feel like I’m always running hot. Like I can’t really shut the motor off. And lately it’s started getting me in trouble at the firehouse.
Have you been feeling like your thoughts are racing or that you need less sleep lately?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say that, exactly. Sleep’s not great sometimes, but I don’t think I’ve been needing less of it or anything. Thoughts racing… maybe just busy, I guess.
Have you been feeling more irritable or unusually high or upbeat lately, even if just for short periods of time?
Not really “high,” no. Irritable… maybe sometimes, but I wouldn’t say it’s unusual. I haven’t noticed anything like that in spells.
Have you noticed that you’re not interested in things you used to enjoy or that you don’t get as much pleasure out of activities lately?
Not really, no. I mean… I still like the same stuff. I haven’t noticed that being a big change or anything.
Have you ever felt like you're seeing or hearing things that others don't, or have you had thoughts that feel strange or not quite real to you?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t been seeing or hearing things like that. And I don’t really know what you mean by thoughts not feeling real, but… nothing comes to mind.
Have you noticed yourself talking more quickly or more than usual, or feeling like you need to keep doing things even when you’re tired?
Yeah… more the second part, I guess. I’m kind of always running hot, like I can’t shut the motor off. Even when I’m wiped out, I keep going, and lately it’s been causing problems at the firehouse.
Have you had periods where your mood was noticeably more elevated, irritable, or 'up' compared to usual, even if it didn’t last very long?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get irritated sometimes, sure, but not like… some separate “up” period or anything I’ve really noticed.
Have you ever found yourself doing a lot of extra activities, taking on more than usual, or feeling like you had to keep moving or doing things even when you didn’t need to?

Yeah. That’s… pretty much why I’m here. I feel like I’m always running hot, like I can’t shut the motor off. Even when there’s no reason to keep going, I’m still moving or finding something to do, and it’s been getting me in trouble at the firehouse lately.
